title: Mika goes live for the first time
goal: A first-time viewer understands: Mika is a streamer, she goes live, chat floods in, she is happy.

shots.title: lights-on
shots.framing: wide: the whole desk, chair and wall LED strip; Mika small but fully in frame
shots.camera: fixed, eye level, from the doorway
shots.start: room dark except the monitor glow; Mika standing next to the desk, right hand on the lamp switch
shots.action: she switches on the warm desk lamp
shots.end: room warmly lit; she sits down in the chair facing the monitor
shots.prompt: A cozy streaming room at night.

shots.title: hello
shots.framing: waist-up, centered, both hands visible on the desk
shots.camera: fixed, eye level, monitor-camera point of view
shots.start: Mika seated, looking into the camera, hands resting on the desk
shots.action: she smiles and gives a small wave with her right hand while talking
shots.end: right hand back on the desk, closed-mouth smile
shots.line: Hi, I'm Mika. This is my very first stream!

shots.title: chat
shots.framing: close-up of the monitor screen, slight angle
shots.action: a soft blur of colorful message bubbles scrolls up quickly
shots.end: the panel is full of blurred bubbles
shots.prompt: Abstract blurred chat bubbles only, nothing legible.

shots.title: reaction
shots.start: Mika looking at the screen, surprised, eyebrows raised
shots.action: her surprise turns into a delighted closed-mouth smile and she claps her hands twice
shots.end: hands together under her chin, smiling at the camera

shots.title: victory-dance
shots.framing: head to knees, standing in front of the desk
shots.start: Mika standing, facing the camera, arms relaxed
shots.action: a short upbeat hand-gesture dance, facing the camera the whole time
shots.end: she finishes on a heart sign with both hands at chest height

shots.title: bye
shots.start: Mika seated, smiling at the camera
shots.action: she waves goodbye with her right hand, then reaches off-frame to the lamp
shots.end: the lamp goes off, the room is lit only by the monitor glow, she is still smiling
